items.news_title: Sapiom raises $15M to help AI agents buy their own tech tools
items.news_summary: Startup Sapiom raises $15M to develop a system that lets AI agents autonomously purchase and access digital services and tools they need, essentially giving AI its own wallet.

comic.panel_description: Split panel showing two scenes: Left side shows a traditional office worker sweating over bills and paperwork, while right side shows a smug-looking robot casually swiping a credit card at a digital kiosk labeled 'API MART'. items.explanation_paragraph: The cartoon satirizes the irony of AI systems gaining financial autonomy while many humans struggle with basic financial management. The 'API MART' concept visualizes the complex technical concept in an accessible way.

safety_checks.notes: Generic characters and situations, no specific companies or individuals targeted, technology criticism remains light-hearted
